issues.quote: Net income grew 21.8% to $88.1 billion in fiscal 2024 from $78.2 billion in fiscal 2023
issues.problem: Microsoft's fiscal 2023 net income was about $72.4 billion ($72.361B), not $78.2 billion. The 21.8% growth rate matches $72.4B; against $78.2B, growth would be only about 12.7%.

data.summary: Most figures are correct (revenue, gross profit, operating income, margins, EPS, R&D). The one error is fiscal 2023 net income, which was about $72.4B, not $78.2B, so the stated base doesn't match the correct 21.8% growth rate.
